invariants: executor exit 0 or PASS enters RETURNED_UNVALIDATED, never COMPLETED_VALIDATED
COMPLETED_VALIDATED requires VALIDATING and independent OS validation
TIMED_OUT_EFFECT_UNKNOWN cannot create a retry lineage
TIMED_OUT_KNOWN_NO_EFFECT permits only a new attempt id
cancel confirmation does not imply effect reversal unless no external effect is proven
unknown, stale, duplicate or unbound receipts are not completion evidence

transition_record.durability_binding: OS transition records are the input boundary for the existing Event Ledger / durable-dispatch integration; no executor state is made canonical.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=ignition python3 -m unittest ignition.tests.test_live_bridge_contracts ignition.tests.test_dispatch_reconciliation ignition.tests.test_durability_recovery ignition.tests.test_durability_revocation -v

claim_ceiling: Repository-local lifecycle and reconciliation semantics only; no executor success, external effect exactly-once claim, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance is inferred.
